title: VisualTalk-Bench: Evaluating Question-Driven Avatar-Led Video Explanations
title_zh: VisualTalk-Bench：评估问题驱动的虚拟人讲解视频
abstract_en: Advances in video generation and avatar synthesis enable new ways to answer user questions through visual explanations. This task requires a system to formulate a correct answer, translate relevant information into visual material, and deliver the explanation through an avatar's speech and actions. Existing benchmarks rarely assess whether avatars point to the visual content being discussed. We introduce VisualTalk-Bench for question-driven avatar-led video explanations in finance and Chinese and English education. It includes 800 curated reference videos and 100 independent evaluation requests, assessing Content Factuality, Speech-Visual Consistency, Visual Quality, Motion Smoothness, and Avatar-Content Pointing. Yet end-to-end video generators often struggle to align gestures with specific visual targets. To explore this challenge, we develop Avatar-O Agent, a modular reference implementation with explicit interaction planning. Experiments across six agents show that factual precision and visual quality do not guarantee accurate pointing. A 26-participant study comparing four agents finds that Avatar-O Agent receives the highest average ratings for visual guidance, perceived pointing accuracy, and explanation effectiveness. We will release the data and code.
abstract_zh: 视频生成与虚拟人合成技术为用视频回答用户提问提供了新途径。这项任务不仅要求系统给出正确答案，还要将关键信息转化为视觉材料，并通过虚拟人的口语和动作完成讲解。然而，现有基准很少检验虚拟人的手势能否准确指向正在讲解的内容。本文提出 VisualTalk-Bench，覆盖金融、中文教育和英文教育，包含 800 个精选参考视频和 100 条独立评估请求，从内容事实准确性、语音与画面一致性、视觉质量、动作流畅度和虚拟人指向准确性五个维度进行评估。针对端到端视频生成器难以将手势与具体视觉目标对齐的问题，作者提出采用显式交互规划的模块化参考实现 Avatar-O Agent。对 6 个智能体的实验表明，内容准确、画面优质并不意味着手势指向准确。在一项由 26 名参与者比较 4 个智能体的用户研究中，Avatar-O Agent 在视觉引导、感知指向准确性和讲解有效性三项上的平均评分均最高。作者计划公开数据和代码。
key_points_zh: VisualTalk-Bench 覆盖金融、中文教育和英文教育，提供 800 个精选参考视频和 100 条独立评估请求。
基准将指向准确性单列为评估维度，与内容事实准确性、语音与画面一致性、视觉质量和动作流畅度区分开来。
Avatar-O Agent 通过显式交互规划处理手势与具体视觉目标的对齐；对 6 个智能体的评测表明，内容准确、画面优质并不能保证指向准确。
在 26 名参与者对 4 个智能体的比较中，Avatar-O Agent 的视觉引导、感知指向准确性和讲解有效性平均评分均最高。
